spans.s:
प्रकङ्कत प्र-कङ्कत, अस्, m., Ved. a veno-
mous species of reptile; (Sāy.) = प्रकृष्ट-विषो
(or प्रकृष्ट-गामी) महोरगः.

प्रकच प्र-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) having
the hair erect; [cf. उत्-क्˚, वि-क्˚.]

प्रकट 1. प्र-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, clear,
manifest, apparent, displayed, unfolded, open; public,
commonly known, undisguised; visible; प्रकटः
सो ऽस्तु, let him show himself; (अस्), m., N. of a
man; (अम्), ind. evidently, clearly, manifestly,
visibly; openly, undisguisedly, in public; अ-प्र-
कटम्, unobservedly; [cf. अव-कट, उत्-क्˚, नि-क्˚,
वि-क्˚, सङ्-क्˚.]
—प्रकट-प्रीति-वर्धन, अस्, m.
an epithet of Śiva.
—प्रकटी-करण, अम्, n.
making visible or apparent, displaying, manifesting.
—प्रकटी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to manifest, bring to light, unfold, display.
—प्रकटी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, brought
to light, unfolded, displayed.
—प्रकटी-भू, cl. 1.
[]
P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become manifest, appear.
—प्रकटी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, manifest.

2. प्रकट, Nom. P. प्रकटति, प्रकटितुम्, to
appear, become manifest.

प्रकटन, अम्, n. manifesting, bringing to
light.

प्रकटय, Nom. P. प्रकटयति, -यितुम्, to
manifest, make manifest, bring to light; to disclose,
evince, display.

प्रकटाय, Nom. P. प्रकटायति, -यितुम्, to
manifest, reveal, promulgate, proclaim.

प्रकटित, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested; evident, ap-
parent; unfolded, displayed, opened, expanded;
publicly proclaimed or exhibited.
—प्रकटित-ह-
ताशेष-तमस् (˚त-अश्˚), अस्, ind. having openly
destroyed utter darkness.

प्रकण्व प्र-कण्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably)
freed from evil (said of a place, Scholiast on Pāṇ.

प्रकथ् प्र-कथ्, cl. 10. P. -कथयति, -यि-
तुम्, to announce, proclaim.

प्र-कथन, अम्, n. announcing, proclaiming,
relating, communicating.

प्रकम्प् प्र-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्-
पितुम्, to tremble, shake, quake, quiver, shudder;
to become lax or loose, to be loosened; to vibrate
(said of sound): Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to tremble; to swing, wave, brandish, shake.

प्र-कम्प, अस्, m. trembling, quivering, shaking,
quaking, staggering, violent motion.

प्र-कम्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to
tremble.

प्र-कम्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling violently,
shaking, quaking, quivering; becoming lax or loose.

प्र-कम्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to tremble,
shaking, agitating.

प्र-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, shaking, mov-
ing to and fro.

प्र-कम्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to tremble,
to be made to shake; [cf. दुष्-प्˚.]

प्रकर 1. and 2. प्र-कर. See under प्र-
कृ, p. 602, and प्र-कॄ, p. 603.

1. प्र-कर, अस्, ई, अम् (for 2. see under प्र-कॄ,
p. 603), doing much, doing well; (अस्), m. aid, assist-
ance, friendship; usage, custom, continuance of a
similar practice; respect; seduction, abduction; (ई),
f. an episodical incident or interlude inserted in a
drama to explain that which follows; theatrical dress
or disguise, as wearing a woman's garb, &c.

2. प्र-कर, अस्, m. (for 1. see under प्र-कृ,
p. 602), a scattered heap, heap, multitude, quantity,
plenty; a bunch of flowers, a nosegay; (ई), f. a kind
of song; an open piece of ground; a place where four
roads meet; the proper site of any magical opera-
tions; (अम्), n. aloe wood, Agallochum.
प्रकार प्र-कार. See प्र-कृ, col. 3.

प्र-कार, अस्, m. sort, kind, species; way, mode,
fashion, manner (in these and the preceding mean-
ings frequently at the end of a comp., e. g. नाना-
प्रकार, of many kinds, manifold; त्रि-प्रकार,
[]
of three kinds, threefold; cf. बहु-प्रकारम्);
similitude; difference; speciality.
—प्रकार-ता, f.
particularity, speciality.
—प्रकार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
belonging to a species or kind.
—प्रकारान्तर
(˚र-अन्˚), अम्, n. another sort or kind, another
manner; (ए), ind. in another way.

प्राकर प्राकर, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Dyuti-mat; (अम्), n., N. of the Varṣa called after
Prākara.

प्राकार प्रा-कार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कॄ and
प्रा for प्र), an encircling wall, enclosure, fence,
rampart (especially a surrounding wall elevated on
a mound of earth).
—प्राकार-कर्ण, अस्, m. ‘wall-
ear,’ N. of a minister of the owl-king Ari-mardana.
—प्राकार-भञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, breaking down
ramparts.
—प्राकारमर्दि, इस्, m. a patronymic
from Prākāra-mardin.
—प्राकार-मर्दिन्, ई, m.
‘rampart-crusher,’ N. of a man.
—प्राकार-स्थ, अस्,
आ, अम्, standing on a wall, stationed on a rampart.

प्रकरण प्र-करण, प्र-कर्तव्य, प्र-
कर्तृ. See प्र-कृ, p. 602, col. 3.

प्र-करण, अम्, n. treatment, discussion, ex-
pounding, explanation; a subject, topic, province,
department; a section, chapter, book, paragraph;
opportunity, occasion; relation; an introduction,
prologue, prelude; a poetical fiction or poem, in
which the story and principal persons are wholly
imaginary; a drama, a kind of drama with a fic-
titious plot; treating with respect; doing much or
well; (ई), f. a drama of the same character as the
Pra-karaṇa but of less extent.
—प्रकरण-त्व,
अम्, n. the being a prelude or introduction.
—प्र-
करण-पञ्चिका, f., N. of a philosophical treatise by
Śālika-nātha; (also called शालिका.)
—प्रकरण-
पाद, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work.
—प्रकरण-
शस्, ind. according to species or kind (opposed to
पृथक्त्वेन).
प्रकरितृ प्र-करितृ. See प्र-कॄ, p. 603.

प्र-करितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who sprinkles;
one who spices or seasons (?).

प्रकर्ष प्र-कर्ष, प्र-कर्षण, &c. See
प्र-कृष्, p. 603.

प्र-कर्ष, अस्, m. pre-eminence, excellence,
eminence, distinction, superiority, intensity of good
qualities or merit, high degree (in these senses fre-
quently at the end of comps.; cf. प्रणय-प्˚,
वपुः-प्˚, वर्ण-प्˚); might, strength; speciality;
universality; absoluteness, definitiveness; protracted-
ness, length; (in grammar) the effect of the prefix
प्र upon roots; (आत्, एण), ind. in a high degree,
intensely, eminently, exceedingly, mightily, strongly.
—प्रकर्ष-गमन, अम्, n. going absolutely or
[]
finally (?).
—प्रकर्ष-तन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, depend-
ent on excellence or intensity of merit; dependent
on superior strength or power.
—प्रकर्ष-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, pre-eminent, eminent, excellent.

प्राकर्ष प्राकर्ष, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-कर्ष),
N. of a Sāman.

प्र-कालन, अस्, आ, अम्, driving, driving on,
chasing, pursuing; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga of the
race of Vāsuki.

प्रकला प्र-कला, f. part of a part, a minute
portion.
—प्रकल-विद्, त्, m., Ved. (according to
the Nirukta) ‘knowing, i. e. calculating the smallest
particles or sums,’ a merchant; (according to Sāy.) =
अ-जानत्, ‘not knowing,’ knowing very little, desti-
tute of knowledge, ignorant.
प्रकल्पना प्र-कल्पना. See प्र-कॢप्, p. 604.

प्र-कल्पना, f. fixing, settlement, allotting, allot-
ment.

प्रकल्याण प्र-कल्याण, अस्, आ, अम्, very
excellent.

प्रकश प्र-कश, अस्, m., Ved. the thong or
lash of a whip; hurting, killing.

प्र-काश, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, manifest, clear,
evident; open, public; generally or universally
known, noted, renowned, famous, celebrated; bright,
shining, brilliant; expanded, blown; (at the end of
a comp.) having the appearance of, looking like,
resembling, like; (अस्), m. clearness, brightness,
brilliance, lustre, splendor, light, elucidation (in this
sense frequently at the end of the titles of explana-
tory works; cf. अर्क-प्˚, तत्त्व-प्˚, तर्क-प्˚);
display, manifestation, expansion, diffusion; publicity,
fame, renown, celebrity; sunshine; the open air, an
open spot or space; (according to Mahī-dhara) =
उपरितन-देह-कान्ति, the gloss on the upper part
of a (horse's) body; a golden mirror (wrongly for
प्राकाश); a chapter, section; laughter (perhaps
wrongly for a form प्र-कास fr. प्र-कस्); N. of a
Brāhman the son of Tamas or Darkness personified;
of a son of Manu Raivata; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet
of the messengers of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. white
metal, bell-metal, brass; (अम्), ind. openly, pub-
licly, undisguisedly, before all eyes (opposed to
अ-प्˚, प्र-च्छन्नम्, रहस्यम्); aloud, audibly
(especially in dramatic language where it is opposed
to आत्म-गतम्, स्व-गतम्, अप-वार्य, जनान्-
तिकम्); (ए), ind. visibly, apparently; before the
world, openly, publicly; in the presence of.
—प्र-
काश-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘maker of light,’ an epithet of
the sun.
—प्रकाश-कर्मन्, आ, m. ‘whose work is
to give light,’ an epithet of the sun.
—प्रकाश-
काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wishing for a splendid ap-
pearance or for distinction.
—प्रकाश-क्रय, अस्,
m. a purchase made publicly.
—प्रकाश-ता, f. or
प्रकाश-त्व, अम्, n. brightness, brilliance, splendor,
luminousness; appearance, manifestation, visibility;
celebrity, renown, fame.
—प्रकाश-देवी, f., N. of a
princess (Rāja-taraṅginī
IV. 79

).
—प्रकाश-नारी,
f. ‘public woman,’ a prostitute, harlot.
—प्रकाश-
वञ्चक, अस्, m. ‘an open rogue,’ public deceiver or
cheat.
—प्रकाश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, brilliant,
shining; (आन्), m., N. of one of the feet of Brahmā.
—प्रकाश-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of a poet men-
tioned in the Śārṅgadhara-paddhati.
—प्रकाशा-
काश-कान्ति (˚श-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, bright as a clear
sky.
—प्रकाशात्मक (˚श-आत्˚), अस्, इका, अम्,
[]
brilliant in character or nature, shining, brilliant.
—प्रकाशात्मक-त्व, अम्, n. the possession of a
brilliant nature or character, brilliancy.
—प्रका-
शात्मन् (˚श-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, brilliant in character or
nature, brilliant, shining; (आ), m. an epithet of
Śiva; the sun; N. of a man; of a philosophical
writer (pupil of Ananyānubhava-svāmin).
—प्रका-
शात्म-पति, इस्, or प्रकाशात्म-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N.
of a philosophical writer (= प्रकाशात्मन्).
—प्र-
काशानन्द (˚श-आन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a philosophical
writer.
—प्रकाशी-करण, अम्, n. giving light,
illuminating, irradiating.
—प्रकाशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A.
-करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to give light, illumine;
to publish, make known.
—प्रकाशी-भाव, अस्, m.
the becoming light, morning twilight.
—प्रकाशे-
तर (˚श-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘other than visible,’
invisible.

प्राकाश प्राकाश, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-काश), Ved.
a metallic mirror; (according to some commentators)
a kind of ornament.

प्रकस् प्र-कस्, Caus. P. -कासयति, -यितुम्,
to drive away, repel, repulse; to cause to bloom.

प्रकाश् प्र-काश्, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.)
-काशते (-ति), -काशितुम्, to become visible, come
to light, come in sight, appear; to shine, gleam,
glitter; to become evident or manifest: Caus. P.
-काशयति, -यितुम्, to make visible, bring to light,
cause to appear; to show, display; to lighten, illu-
mine, irradiate; to discover, disclose, unfold, mani-
fest, reveal; to make known, impart, communicate,
proclaim: Pass. -काश्यते, to be illumined, &c.:
Caus. A. -काशयते, -यितुम्, to cause to appear; to
explain: Intens., Ved. -चाकशीति, to irradiate, illumine;
to survey.

प्रकाङ्क्ष् प्र-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. -काङ्क्षति,
काङ्क्षितुम्, to wish for, desire.

प्रकाण्ड प्र-काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. the stem
[]
or trunk of a tree from the root to the branches; a
branch, a shoot; (अस्), m. the upper part of the
arm [cf. प्र-गण्ड]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. anything
excellent of its kind (at the end of a comp.; cf.
गो-प्˚, मन्त्रि-प्˚).

प्रकाण्डक, अस्, m. = प्र-काण्ड (at the end of
a comp.; cf. रक्षः-प्˚).
प्रकाण्डर, अस्, m. a tree.

प्रकाम प्र-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, amorous; (अस्),
m. desire, delight, pleasure, luxury; (अम्), ind.
according to wish or desire, with great pleasure, to
the heart's content; voluntarily, willingly; sufficiently;
very much; indeed.
—प्रकाम-तस्, ind. willingly,
with great pleasure or delight, to the heart's content;
at will, according to the will.
—प्रकाम-भुज्, क्,
क्, क्, eating till satisfied, eating enough.
—प्रकाम-
विस्तार, अस्, m. great expansiveness (according to
Malli-nātha = अत्यन्त-विशालता).
—प्रकामालोक-
नीय-ता (˚म-आल्˚), f. the being an object that may
be viewed at pleasure.
—प्रकामोद्य (˚म-उद्˚),
अम्, n., Ved. talking to the heart's content, talkative-
ness, garrulity.

प्र-काशक, अस्, इका, अम्, clear, bright, shining,
brilliant; universally known, noted, renowned; irra-
diating, illuminating, giving light, luminous; making
apparent or manifest, disclosing, discovering, pub-
lishing; evincing, betraying; expressing; explaining;
(अस्), m. ‘the giver of light,’ the sun; an expounder,
illustrator; a publisher; a discoverer; (इका), f., N.
of a commentary on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtra by Rāma-
kṛṣṇa.
—प्रकाशक-ज्ञातृ, ता, m. ‘knowing the
giver of light, i. e. the sun,’ a cock.
—प्रकाशक-
त्व, अम्, n. luminousness, radiance.

प्र-काशन, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminating, giving
light; making known; (अस्), m. ‘the giver of light,’
an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. causing to appear,
displaying; illuminating, giving light; bringing to
light, making clear or manifest, making known,
publicly showing or manifesting; (आ), f. propound-
ing, explaining, teaching.
—प्रकाशन-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, irradiating, illuminating.

प्र-काशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be displayed, to be
shown or manifested.

प्र-काशमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming manifest,
appearing; shining, splendid, brilliant, radiant.

प्र-काशित, अस्, आ, अम्, become visible, brought
to light, visible, manifest, apparent, evident; dis-
played, unfolded, discovered; illumined, enlightened,
irradiated; published, promulgated.

प्र-काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, visible, clear, bright, shin-
ing; making visible or manifest.
—प्रकाशि-ता, f. or
प्रकाशि-त्व, अम्, n. clearness, brightness, brilliance,
light.

प्र-काश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be illuminated or en-
lightened; to be brought to light or made manifest;
(अम्), n. light, clearness, distinctness (in this sense
a wrong form for प्राकाश्य, q. v.).
—प्रकाश्य-ता,
f. the being manifest; publicity; the being illu-
minated.

प्राकाश्य, अम्, n. the being evident or manifest,
publicity; celebrity, fame, renown.
प्रकिरण प्र-किरण. See प्र-कॄ, p. 603.

प्र-किरण, अम्, n. scattering, strewing, throwing
about.

प्रकीर्तन प्र-कीर्तन, प्र-कीर्तित, प्र-
कीर्त्ति. See प्र-कॄत्, p. 604, col. 1.
प्रकीर्य प्र-कीर्य. See प्र-कॄ, p. 603.

प्र-कीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be strewed or scattered,
to be spread abroad or about; to be diffused or
[]
promulgated; to be expanded or extended; (अस्), m.
the plant Guilandina Bonduc.

प्रकुञ्च प्रकुञ्च, अस्, m. a particular
measure of capacity (somewhat more or less than
a handful).

प्रकुट् प्र-कुट् or प्र-कुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. -कुट-
यति, -कुट्टयति, -यितुम्, to divide, reduce to small
pieces.

प्रकुथ् प्र-कुथ्, cl. 4. P. -कुथ्यति, -कोथि-
तुम्, to become putrid, turn putrid, begin to stink.
प्र-कुथित, अस्, आ, अम्, putrid, putrescent.

प्र-कोथ, अस्, m. putrefaction, putridity, putres-
cence.
—प्रकोथोदक (˚थ-उद्˚), अम्, n. filthy
water.

प्रकुप् प्र-कुप्, cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्यति, -ते,
-कोपितुम्, to be moved or agitated; to become
enraged, fly into a passion: Caus. -कोपयति, -यि-
तुम्, to provoke to anger, incense.

प्र-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, agitated, moving
to and fro (Sāy. = इतस् ततश् चलित); very angry,
[]
wroth, enraged, incensed; disordered; अति-प्रकु-
पित, excessively irritated.
प्र-कुप्त, anomalously for प्र-कुपित.

प्र-कुप्य, ind. having become angry, being
enraged.

प्र-कोप, अस्, m. effervescence, ebullition, excite-
ment, emotion, violent anger, rage, fury, wrath, ire,
anger; irritation, provocation, exasperation; political
disturbance, insurrection, mutiny; an attack; (in medi-
cine) excess, superabundance, vitiation [cf. पित्त-प्˚,
वात-प्˚].

प्र-कोपण or प्र-कोपन, अस्, ई, अम्, exciting,
agitating, irritating, provoking; (अम्), n. irritating,
provoking, irritation, provocation, incensing.

प्र-कोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be irritated or
incensed, to be provoked to anger, irritable.

प्र-कोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, irritated, provoked, in-
censed, enraged.

प्र-कोपितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, exciting, agitating, dis-
quieting, an exciter, agitator.

प्रकुल प्र-कुल, अम्, n. a handsome or
excellent body; (also read प्रह्वल.)

प्रकूर्द् प्र-कूर्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -कूर्दति, -ते,

प्र-क्रमणीय, or प्र-क्रमितव्य, or प्र-
क्रम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone or proceeded.

प्र-क्रममाण, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeding, be-
ginning; overcoming.

प्र-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded; gone
beyond, surpassed; commenced, begun; preceded,
previously mentioned, previously laid down or stated;
(अम्), n. the outset of a journey; the point in
question.
—प्रक्रान्त-त्व, अम्, n. beginning, com-
mencing; the being begun; the being stated or
mentioned previously.

प्रक्रय प्र-क्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. क्री with
प्र), sale (?).
प्र-क्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. to be bought, purchasable.

प्रक्रीड् प्र-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रीडति, -ते,
-क्रीडितुम्, to play, sport, disport one's self, gambol,
frolic, amuse one's self.

प्र-क्रीड, अस्, m. play, pastime; a place of
sports, play-ground (Ved.); मरुताम् प्रक्रीडः,
N. of a Sāman.
प्र-क्रीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, played, playing, sporting.

प्र-क्रीडिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. playing, sporting;
playful, sportive, frolicsome.
प्र-क्रोश, अस्, m., Ved. a shriek, scream.

प्रक्लिद् प्र-क्लिद्, cl. 4. A. -क्लिद्यते, -क्लेदि-
तुम्, -क्लेत्तुम्, to become moist or humid, to be-
come wet: Caus. -क्लेदयति, -यितुम्, to moisten,
wet, make wet.

प्र-क्लिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, moist, humid, wet,
soaked, saturated; moved with compassion or sym-
pathy.
—प्रक्लिन्न-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. a kind of dis-
ease of the eyelids; [cf. क्लिन्न-वर्त्मन्.]
—प्र-
क्लिन्न-हृदयेक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having the
heart and eyes moist (with affection).

प्र-क्लेद, अस्, m. moistness, wetness, humidity.
—प्रक्लेद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, moistening, wetting.

प्र-क्लेदन, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्र-क्लेदिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, moistening, wetting.

प्रक्वण प्र-क्वण or प्र-क्वाण, अस्, m. (fr.
rt. क्वण् with प्र), the sound of a Vīṇā or lute.
प्रक्षय प्र-क्षय. See col. 3.
प्र-क्षय, अस्, m. destruction, ruin.

प्रक्षर् प्र-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. -क्षरति, -क्ष-
रितुम्, to stream, trickle forth, ooze; to drop down.

प्र-क्षर, अस्, m. iron armour for the defence
of a horse or elephant; [cf. प्र-खर, प्रक्-
खर.]

प्र-क्षरण, अम्, n. flowing forth, trickling
out, oozing, dripping.

प्रक्षल् प्र-क्षल्, cl. 10. P. -क्षालयति,
-यितुम्, to wash off, wash away, rinse; to cleanse,
clean, purify: Caus. to cause to wash.

प्र-क्षालक, अस्, आ, अम्, washing, one who
washes; [cf. सद्यः-प्˚.]

प्र-क्षालन, अस्, आ, अम्, performing frequent
ablutions, one who performs frequent ablutions; (अम्),
n. washing, washing off, cleaning, cleansing, purify-
ing; bathing; a means of cleaning, anything used
for purifying, water for washing.
—प्रक्षालनार्-
थाय (˚न-अर्˚), ind. for the sake of washing.

प्राक्षालन प्राक्षालन, an incorrect form
for प्र-क्षालन, q. v.

प्र-क्षालनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be washed away
or cleansed; to be purified.

प्र-क्षालित, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, cleansed; ex-
piated.

1. प्र-क्षाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be washed or
purified.
2. प्र-क्षाल्य, ind. having washed, having rinsed.

प्रक्षि प्र-क्षि, cl. 9. 5. 1. P. -क्षिणाति,
[]
क्षिणोति, -क्षयति, -क्षेतुम्, to spoil, injure,
wear out, exhaust, destroy: Pass. -क्षीयते, to be
destroyed, perish, to be worn out or exhausted; to
be diminished.

प्र-क्षयण, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to perish,
destroying.

प्र-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, decayed, wasting; de-
stroyed; atoned; vanished, disappeared; (अम्), n.
the spot where any one has perished (e. g. प्रक्षी-
णम् इडं देव-दत्तस्य, this is the spot where
Deva-datta perished).

प्रक्षिप् प्र-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति,
-ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw or fling at, throw or cast
into; to project; to hurl; to put or lay before; to
insert, interpolate: Caus. -क्षेपयति, -यितुम्, to
cause or order to cast or put into.

प्र-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast at,
hurled, flung; thrown forth, projected.

प्र-क्षिप्तवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has thrown
at, one who has thrown.
प्र-क्षिप्य, ind. having thrown at, having hurled.

प्र-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing or casting forth or
forward, projecting; a throw, cast; throwing into or
upon, scattering upon; insertion, interpolation; any-
thing added or thrown into drugs while in course of
decoction, an ingredient; the sum deposited by each
member of a commercial company; the box of a
carriage.
—प्रक्षेप-लिपि, इस्, f. a particular style
of handwriting.

प्र-क्षेपण, अम्, n. throwing, casting; pouring
upon, throwing on, throwing into; fixing (as a
price).

प्र-क्षेपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown or cast
forth, to be thrown away.

प्र-क्षेपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, throwing upon, placing
upon.

प्र-क्षेप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown into
or upon, to be scattered upon; to be scattered.
प्र-क्षेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown or put on.

प्रक्षीवित प्र-क्षीवित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
क्षीव् with प्र), drunken, intoxicated.

प्रक्षुद् प्र-क्षुद्, cl. 7. P. -क्षुणत्ति, -क्षोत्-
तुम्, to pound, crush; to break; to pierce, pierce
through.

प्र-क्षुण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed; pierced through,
lacerated; incited.

प्रक्षुभ् प्र-क्षुभ्, cl. 1. A., 4. P. -क्षो-
भते, -क्षुभ्यति, -क्षोभितुम्, to be moved, to
be shaken or agitated; to totter, stagger; to be
confused: Caus. -क्षोभयति, -यितुम्, to agitate,
excite.
प्र-क्षोभण, अम्, n. agitating, exciting.

प्रक्षै प्र-क्षै, cl. 1. P. -क्षायति, -क्षा-
तुम्, to be consumed, to burn (intrans.).

प्रक्ष्णु प्र-क्ष्णु, cl. 2. P. -क्ष्णौति, -क्ष्ण-
वितुम्, to sharpen, whet, point.

प्रक्ष्वेडन प्र-क्ष्वेडन or प्र-क्ष्वेदन,
अस्, आ, m. f. (fr. rt. क्ष्विड् or क्ष्विद् with प्र),
clamour, a loud indistinct noise; an iron arrow.

प्र-क्ष्वेडा, f. humming, grumbling, an inarti-
culate sound.

प्र-क्ष्वेडित or प्र-क्ष्वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्,
clamorous, shouting, making a loud indistinct noise;
unctuous.
—प्रक्ष्वेडित-वत् or प्रक्ष्वेदित-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, noisy; unctuous.
प्राक् प्राक्. See p. 653, col. 2.

प्राकट्य प्राकट्य, अम्, n. publicity, mani-
festation, notoriety.
प्राकर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, deserving preference.

प्राकषिक प्राकषिक, अस्, m. (said to be
fr. rt. कष् with प्र-आ), a dancer employed by a
woman, one supported by another's wife; a catamite.

प्राकाम्य प्राकाम्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-काम),
freedom of will; wilfulness, following or obeying
one's own will or inclination; irresistible will or fiat
(one of the eight attributes of Śiva).

प्राकारीय, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for a wall, of or be-
longing to a wall; enclosed by a wall, walled.

प्राकारुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. कॄ with प्र-आ?),
Ved. scattering about (?).

प्राकृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-
kṛta.

प्राकृतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to
Pra-kṛti or the original element, material, natural,
illusory.
प्राक्कर्मन् प्राक्-कर्मन्, &c. See p. 653.

प्राक्रियाकौमुद प्राक्रियाकौमुद, अस्, ई, अम्,
belonging or relating to the Prakriyā-kaumudī, q. v.

प्राक्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, former, prior, previous,
anterior, antecedent, preceding; early, old, ancient,
(opposed to इदानीन्तन); relating to a former state
of existence, resulting from acts done in a former
[]
life.
—प्राक्तन-कर्मन्, अ, n. any act formerly
done or done in a former state of existence; fate,
destiny.
—प्राक्तन-जन्मन्, अ, n. a former birth.

प्राक्तस् or प्राक्तात्, ind., Ved. from the front,
from the east.
